test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 29 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Sachin ran 15 metres east from the starting point A. He then took a left turn and ran 25 metres, after which he took a right turn and ran another 5 metres. He took one last right turn and ran 25 metres until he reached point B. How far and in which direction should he run in order to reach point A? (All turns are 90-degree turns only, unless specified.)
solution:
Given:

Sachin starts from A and runs 15 metres East.

He turns left → 25 metres North.

He turns right → 5 metres East.

He turns right → 25 metres South and reaches B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c9fc7db5ed70007a704ab57ac6b6ac6b22505f495e11ffedb31b8c882cbb36e.png] 

So, To reach A from B → move 20 metres West.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3.**
